cardArt.title: BOQ Platinum Visa CC Card Art

product.description: Everything you need, with all of the platinum credit card benefits – earn Q Reward® points for every dollar spent on eligible transactions, purchase protection insurance, international and domestic travel insurance, and more.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Earn a taxable income of $35,000 per year or more
Be a permanent Australian resident or citizen
Be at least 18 years of age

features.additionalInfo: Mobile Phone cover for accidental damage and theft up to a limit of $1,650 p.a. (with $1,000 per claim). Excess of $50 per claim.
3 points per $1 on groceries, 2 points per $1 on dining, 1 point per $1 on all other eligible transactions
0% p.a. on Balance Transfers for 12 months. with a 3% Balance Transfer fee. Reverts to the cash advance rate
Earn 100,000 Q Rewards® Bonus Points when you spend $4,500 on eligible purchases within 90 days from approval
Up to 44 days interest free for your purchases (Interest Free Days are not available if you have a Balance Transfer).

Extended Warranty Insurance, cardholders may be entitled to extended warranty insurance of up to 12 months in addition to the covered product's Australian warranty period, which you purchase on your BOQ Platinum Visa Credit Card

Purchase Protection Insurance, cardholders receive 90 days complimentary insurance against loss, theft or accidental damage on covered products purchased anywhere in the world using your BOQ Platinum Visa Credit Card up to specified amounts
Priority 24/7 customer service for your card enquiries.
$1,000 daily cash advance limit through ATMs.

fees.additionalInfo: International cash withdrawals made outside Australia on your credit card. Minimum fee amount of $4.00 and maximum amount of $30.00 debited to your Account on the Transaction Date.

fees.additionalInfo: Fee for each time we do not receive the Minimum Payment Due and any Overdue Amount by the payment due date, debited to your Account after the payment due date.

lendingRates.additionalInfo: Except to the extent that an interest free period applies, you must pay interest on everything charged to your account. Interest is charged monthly at the end of each statement period. We calculate interest for each balance type at its applicable APR for each statement period. The APR (Annual Percentage Rate) that applies to each balance type (e.g. a balance transfer) also applies to related fees and interest. The Retail APR applies to retail purchase balance. To calculate that interest, we multiply the applicable daily percentage rate by the daily unpaid balance of its balance type (including related fees and interest) for each day of that statement period, and then add those amounts together. The daily percentage rate is the applicable APR divided by 365. Information on any APR is available on request.
